comparison.objective: Receive a terminal block and snap it onto a loose DIN rail, versus adjust and commission a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Human-safe handover and forceful snap-latching differ from recessed tool use, fine rotary adjustment, locking, and iterative impact observation.
comparison.success_condition: Clean handover and sub-millimetre rail latch without disturbing the rail versus two non-bottoming stops and witness-tested collar retention.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and force control are generic; the mechanisms and tested abilities differ.
